name: impact-rebated-fees
description: Uniswap v4 hook that settles swap fees after the fact based on realised markout

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.seed: cd contracts && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && forge script script/Seed.s.sol --rpc-url https://sepolia.unichain.org --broadcast --slow --private-key $PRIVATE_KEY --sig "demo()"
scripts.settle: cd contracts && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && forge script script/Seed.s.sol --rpc-url https://sepolia.unichain.org --broadcast --slow --private-key $PRIVATE_KEY --sig "settle()"
